title: Common-cause groups
description: Entities of one class that agree on all `group_by` attributes are hit together by the listed threats. Paths are attributes of the entity in the plan, `catalog.<column>` for its lookup row, and `<list>[].<field>` for a list-valued field (compared as a set). An empty `group_by` puts every entity of the class in one group; a missing attribute equals a missing attribute, except that entities lacking all grouping attributes never form a group.
